description: This Java class provides a simple implementation for audio output using Android's AudioTrack API. It manages creating, starting, stopping, and writing audio data to an audio stream, primarily for experimentation or redirecting audio output in examples.

classes.name: SimpleAudioOutput
classes.description: A class for managing audio output streams, creating and controlling an AudioTrack instance.

methods.name: SimpleAudioOutput
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the SimpleAudioOutput object.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Creates and starts the audio track with the specified frame rate.

methods.name: createAudioTrack
methods.description: Creates an AudioTrack object configured for stereo PCM float audio.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes audio data to the AudioTrack buffer.
